review_mode: read-only source and retained evidence; no builds/tests/process management/Git mutations/source changes

findings.title: Validate opaque D1 grants before any composed file effect
findings.evidence: D2 checks the content plan hash and command count, then checks preparation currentness, but never checks each ProcessGrant against its Prepared. D1 assigns a fresh private prepared id on every prepare; identical inspect DTOs hash to the same D2 identity. Approval from preparation A passes D2 preflight for equivalent preparation B. C3 files.execute runs at line 802, and only subsequent D1 execute rejects the wrong prepared id.
findings.fix: Expose a read-only D1 exact grant validation port that preserves its existing host/prepared/currentness checks, use it for every command in D2 complete preflight before file effects, and retain the execution recheck.
findings.regression: Prepare identical command/file plans twice without state changes; approve first, execute second with that approval; assert typed NeedsAuthority and zero file/command effects. Then execute with a fresh matching grant successfully.

findings.title: Preserve original C3 operation subject across repeated recovery
findings.evidence: save writes file_subject from Files::identity on every save. Initial Apply identity equals the C3 binding grant_subject; a retained recovery plan identity is a different hash. C3 execute_retained_inner preserves grant_subject when plan.recovery is true (generic/inverse.rs 394-400). After the first recovery saves, a second prepare_recovery_with_files compares the new recovery identity to the original binding subject and refuses at client_deploy.rs 420. Even cooperative cancellation before dispatch invokes save and causes this mismatch.
findings.fix: Keep the original C3 operation subject immutable in D2 retained state and separate it from the fresh retained-plan approval identity; validate target/resource/subject joins on every continuation. Do not weaken the C3 equality check.
findings.regression: Combined file+command apply stops after a command effect; cold recover with fresh C3/D1 admission, cancel at a durable boundary, then cold recover again with fresh admission. Same run resumes, original C3 subject remains, landed effects execute once, foreign state survives.

findings.title: Reconcile the receipt publication boundary within the retained run
findings.evidence: Receipt is published before sidecar promotion, intent retirement and final client record save. The durable client record still contains the previous receipt_digest until that final save. Crash or publication error in this interval leaves an owned completed/partial prefix, but execute refuses its own new receipt as changed at client_deploy.rs 734-737. Fresh D1/C3 authority cannot repair this journal join.
findings.fix: Retain a durable exact finalization intent/basis before receipt publication and reconcile a matching own receipt/sidecar/intent during recovery using existing DeployState/Transaction ownership. Refuse foreign joins; do not merely ignore receipt mismatch or create a new run.
findings.regression: Deterministically stop after receipt publication and before final client-record publication (also cover sidecar/intent finalization stages). Cold inspect/recover with fresh authority must complete the same operation without repeating landed commands and must reject a genuinely foreign receipt.

findings.title: Connect trusted host injection to the real CLI entry path
findings.evidence: The production --client-deploy branch always calls client_deploy::exchange with None. The helper immediately errors on None and is in a private module; its only Some(route) caller is a unit test with empty input. Lifecycle CLI tests subsequently drive ClientDeployMachineSessionRunner directly. Thus the declared CLI mode cannot execute any lifecycle verb through a reachable trusted composition path.
findings.fix: Thread an explicitly supplied trusted client host through an actual callable CLI composition/dispatch entry, preserving default ungranted refusal and using the same frame runner. Do not create ambient grants or vendor discovery.
findings.regression: Drive the real CLI dispatch entry with an injected controlled host and actual framed plan/apply/verify/update/remove/recover input; compare typed owner outcomes. Also assert ordinary ungranted startup refuses.

evidence_gap.explanation: All 471 recorded V1-V7 subjects match current bytes, and final 114-file SOURCE-CLOSURE matches current bytes. Per-test manifests omit new implementation and tests plus two approved owner extensions. Therefore final changed-file hashes alone cannot establish that every current body was the tested body. Bind the full consumed new/extended closure before and after correction checks.
